title: Swan River Glide
style: 105 bpm, sunset disco-funk, smooth groove, brass section, electric piano, fretless bass, soft live drums, male and female duet, golden hour cruise vibe, warm tape saturation
lyrics:
[Intro - smooth, brass swell, sunset funk]
Swan River glide, the city slides by
Golden hour painting up the sky

[Verse 1 - Male Lead, smooth]
Corporate suits step onto the deck
Ties come off, no one checks the clock yet
Pete eases the throttle, the river opens wide
Brandon's engine purring like it's family pride
Perth city skyline catching the gold
The Pelican glides, the story gets told

[Pre-Chorus - Fem Lead, harmony]
No phones in the air, no screens in the eye
Just the river and the brass and the slow goodbye
Three thirty six, the sun's coming down
Swan River glide, the smoothest sound in town

[Chorus - Duet, sunset disco]
Swan River glide — Swan River glide
Pete at the wheel, Brandon at his side
Swan River glide — the city beside
No machines between us — just the river and the ride

[Verse 2 - Male Lead]
Fremantle in the rearview, Rotto on the mind
The ocean's just a corner that the river couldn't find
Bucks night roar or a quiet family run
The Pelican carries it, every single one
No comments on the timeline, no scrolling on the feed
Just the brass and the bass and the family creed

[Bridge - Fem Lead, soft]
My brother and his partner, the river and the sea
Pete and Brandon and the Pelican family
No trauma, no panic, no rush, no rank
Just the slow gold light on the riverbank

[Outro - brass fade]
Swan River glide — the sun goes down
Pete on the helm, no rush in this town
Brandon below, the engines hum slow
Swan River glide — let the family go
